text:
maria-partnerships: Hey team — prepping the next SI Accelerator cohort next month. Need a concise infra readiness checklist + training cadence we can share with hardware partners and marketplace ops. Goal: onboarding 6 SIs, each with a sandbox and one marketplace listing QA slot.

aj-eng-ops: +1. Do we have the sandbox quotas carved out on the cloud accounts yet?

neha-solutions: Not yet, I can request quotas but need exact GPU types and counts per SI.

maria-partnerships: Plan is: 4x A10G-equivalents per SI for initial tests, plus 1x vCPU-heavy instance for CI. Also need persistent S3 buckets for logs.

oliver-partner-ops: Copy. I'll DM the hardware partners for confirmation on provisioning windows. @maria-partnerships do we want staggered access (2 SIs week1, 4 SIs week2) or parallel?

maria-partnerships: Staggered preferred — gives us room to iterate on the marketplace QA flow. Week1: 2 SIs, Week2: 4 SIs.

jenna-education: For training: propose 3 live sessions (intro infra + deployment runbook, marketplace publish checklist, troubleshooting & cert prep) and an on-demand lab with step-by-step. Each live session ~90m.

aj-eng-ops: Sounds good. Can we get a quick preflight checklist document? I can use it to request quotas.

maria-partnerships: Quick checklist draft below — please edit and call out missing items.

```
SI Accelerator Infra Preflight Checklist (draft)
- Cloud accounts: AWS org + role for SI -> confirmed
- GPU quota: 4x A10G-equivalents per SI in target region
- CI instance: 1x c6i or equivalent per SI
- Storage: 200GB persistent per SI, S3 buckets with lifecycle rules
- Network: VPC peering or temporary VPN for private deployments (if requested)
- KMS access: KMS key shared for test artifacts (customer-managed optional)
- Marketplace test slot: 1 scheduled QA window (2h) per SI
- Observability: Temp Datadog/APM access + read-only dashboards
- Test dataset: sample prompt set, 3 load profiles (burst, steady, ramp)
- Training access: links to lab, recordings, and cert exam window
```

neha-solutions: Add: quantized model variants for low-memory smoke tests, and a KV-cache warmup script.

sam-platform: Also add: model version pinning policy during cohort (no auto-upgrades), and a rollback play if inference latency > 500ms p50 for the QA tests.

oliver-partner-ops: From partners: need at least 72h notice to schedule physical hardware swaps and 48h for cloud quota increases. I'll build those into the intake form.

jenna-education: For cohort certs: propose a short practical lab + 30-question quiz. Passing gets "SI Accelerator: Redwood Integrator (Foundations)" badge. We can schedule the lab after marketplace QA slot.

maria-partnerships: Great — timeline idea: Week0: intake + quota requests, Week1: sandbox access + intro session (2 SIs), Week2: marketplace QA + cert labs (4 SIs), Week3: follow-ups and official badges.

aj-eng-ops: I'll open quota tickets today with the checklist. Tagging @onboard-bot to create a cohort bucket and invite links.

onboard-bot: Created cohort bucket redwood-si-260111 and generated invite links for 6 SIs. Links expire in 14 days. :white_check_mark:

neha-solutions: Shared a small script for KV-cache warmup in the cohort repo: `scripts/warm_kv.sh` (usage: `./scripts/warm_kv.sh <model> <prefix_file>`).

sam-platform: I'll draft the marketplace QA runbook template (includes test cases, pass/fail, and rollback criteria) and post it to the partnership drive by EOD tomorrow.

maria-partnerships: Awesome. Who wants to volunteer to own cohort comms and the intake form?

oliver-partner-ops: I can own intake + scheduling.

jenna-education: I'll own training calendar + cert proctoring.

aj-eng-ops: I'll track infra provisioning and quotas.

maria-partnerships: Perfect. Next sync: Tuesday 10am PT to confirm tickets and first sandbox activation. Reminder: keep messages short in the cohort channel and use the intake form for requests. :rocket:

sam-platform: Added to calendar.

onboard-bot: Scheduled reminder for Tuesday 10:00 PT to channel `#partnerships` and invited participants.
